arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Barnette argued Home Depot is a defendant. He stated Home Depot did not sue anyone. He denied Home Depot is a counterclaim defendant.
Justice Sotomayor questioned the claim-by-claim analysis. She noted the statute speaks of removing an action. She asked if the theory fails without that analysis.
Justice Sotomayor asked why Home Depot does not need Jackson's approval. She noted Jackson opposes the removal. She questioned the right of an involuntary plaintiff to remove.
